typography.rationale: Outfit provides a modern, geometric structure suitable for dense numeric data without feeling generic. IBM Plex Sans is purpose-built for highly technical, data-dense enterprise applications.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text-primary (#06182F) on surface (#FFFFFF) for maximum readability. Yamini Orange (#F28C18) should only be used for primary CTAs and key highlights, not for body text.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute. Convention: kebab-case, role-based. e.g., `data-testid="sidebar-inventory-link"`.

charts.styling: Use crisp lines (strokeWidth={2}). Use faint dashed grid lines (#E5E7EB) or remove vertical grids entirely. Tooltips must have a solid white background with #E5E7EB border and soft shadow. DO NOT use transparent backgrounds for tooltips.

icons.style: Use regular or bold weights for high-density, crisp visibility. Avoid extremely thin/light icons.

instructions_to_main_agent: You have .js files not .tsx file. All components must be written in standard modern Javascript and React.
DO NOT use a fully transparent background in header or dropdowns. Ensure solid #FFFFFF or solid #06182F.
Do NOT center align the app container. Never add .App { text-align: center; }. Everything must be left-aligned according to modern dashboard standards.
Utilize standard 12-column CSS Grid structure for the dashboard to achieve maximum information density without breaking the layout.
Use Phosphor Icons for an enterprise feel. Install via `yarn add @phosphor-icons/react`.
For KPI Cards, position the main metric at the top or center, and use a small red/green trend indicator. No bloated whitespace.
Implement Sonner for toast notifications at the top-right.
Tables should be dense. Use `py-3` on cells, not `py-4` or `py-6`. Enterprise users want to see more data, not more padding.
Avoid generic border radii. Use `rounded-md` for buttons/inputs, `rounded-lg` for cards/panels.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Focus on high information density, precise alignment, and professional aesthetics. Eliminate all generic 'AI slop' gradients or rounded, playful shapes. This is an enterprise tool. Use data-testid on every interactive element. Do not create placeholder images; use the provided image URLs. Strictly follow the color palette—Yamini Orange is the accent, Deep Navy is the anchor.
